audit.why: Difficulty framing holds: even lane (50.85% over 706 games), Qiyana owns the 1v1 phases against an immobile mage, Orianna takes over grouped play at 2+ items. Content layer states it; full-layer chart said Skill everywhere (fixed).
Spikes correct and complete (4 entries): lvl 3-5 dash dominance, lvl 6 R out-burst when Shockwave (110s rank 1) is down, 1st item delete, 2+ items swing to Orianna's teamfight R.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five ability names miss Riot's colon convention (Command Attack / Command Protect / Command Dissonance / Command Shockwave) in spikes[0], spikes[1], early. breakdown.cooldowns has no digit despite Orianna's Q dropping to 3s at max rank being the defining fact of her poke tempo.
audit.why: Packet suspectNames confirms the real names are Command: Attack etc.; kit gives Q 7/6/5/4/3, E 9, R 110/95/80.
audit.corrected: Colons inserted; cooldowns field rewritten with Q 7s→3s, E 9s shield, R 110/95/80s.

edits.before: Orianna is immobile with no pre-6 kill threat, so your dashes dominate. Watch where she leaves the ball: if it's on the wave for Q Command Attack poke, W Terrashape and E Audacity in on her body while the ball is out of position. She'll try E Command Protect's shield and W Command Dissonance slow to disengage, but neither stops a committed combo. Punish her every time the ball isn't sitting on herself.
edits.after: Orianna is immobile with no pre-6 kill threat, so your dashes dominate. She'll try the E Command: Protect shield and W Command: Dissonance slow to disengage, but neither stops a committed combo. Punish her every time the ball isn't sitting on herself.

edits.before: R Supreme Display of Talent lets you all-in her whenever her R Command Shockwave is on cooldown or the ball is away from her. In a straight 1v1 you burst her before she can pull, so bait or track her ult. Just don't dive into a ball-on-self Orianna with R up, since a self-cast Shockwave plus her jungler ends you.

edits.before: Two items swing to Orianna. Her R Command Shockwave becomes a game-swinging teamfight pull and her E shield plus W slow peel any dive, so flanking a grouped Orianna gets you caught. Kill her only in side skirmishes where the ball can't be everywhere; in 5v5 respect that her utility outscales your single pick.
